Accel Audio browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Accel OD-SS Express Overdrive Published on September 24, 2014 Accel Audio overdrive pedal Information Accel Audio Accel's OD-SS Express Overdrive, delivers those traditional overdrive tones using the classic JRC 4558 chip, at a fraction of the cost. The OD-SS Express Overdrive is equipped with a toggle switch that has three modes. Each mode makes a subtle change to the tone: Normal, Bright and Warm. As with all Accel pedals, a five year limited warranty is included. Features: Uses the classic JRC4558 chip Controls: Volume, Tone, Drive Toggle Switch: Normal/Bright/Warm. True bypass design. Sealed dust proof metal pots for long life Power Source: 9Volt battery, DC9V adapter or Power Supply designed for 9V effects pedals (not included).
